method.inputs: Only three uploaded SSW1 textbooks; no SSW2 PDFs opened
method.printedPage: numeric center-footer extraction; compare body offset; frontmatter/colophon unprinted
method.tables: PyMuPDF Page.find_tables default geometric line detection; counts may include decoration or omit borderless/image tables
method.images: embeddedImageObjects counts distinct image xrefs referenced perpage; imagePlacements counts displayed placements via get_image_info; repeated objects do not equal unique illustrations
method.vectors: path and primitive counts include page decoration, table borders, diagrams and glyph outlines; not semantic figure counts
method.formulae: heuristic count of text lines with operators/technical units; not complete formula count; equations split into spans may be missed
method.captions: heuristic caption IDs from extracted Japanese text; may include references rather than actual captions
method.matrixLinking: exact start-page links and nearest preceding TOC context only; not proof of semantic coverage
method.sourceRedistribution: no source prose, image payloads or PDFpage renders included
